lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a multi-row horizontal lattice across the mid-flank. In the anterior section, a specific grouping of four large-diameter spots forms a distinct rectangular sub-constellation relative to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows. Grid-like nodes are formed where circular blobs are positioned centrally within these vertical bands, most notably in the posterior region of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal line of contrast is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side to low-intensity pixels on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark, elongated pixel cluster is positioned immediately below the ventral margin of the pectoral fin.
